summary: Tank kneels beside Morpheus's body, mourning him as a father figure while Trinity watches with tears. Neo interrupts, refusing to accept that Morpheus is dead and citing the Oracle's prophecy that he would have to choose between Morpheus's life and his own. Neo declares that he is not the One and that Morpheus is the one who matters. He decides to re-enter the Matrix to save Morpheus, arguing that he believes he can bring him back. Tank argues it is suicide, but Neo persists. Trinity initially tries to stop him, then joins him, asserting her authority as the ranking officer and her personal belief that Morpheus means more to her than to Neo. The scene ends with Trinity ordering Tank to load them up.

what_changes.before: Paralyzed by the finality of Morpheus's death and the Oracle's prophecy
what_changes.after: Determined to re-enter the Matrix to save Morpheus based on belief
what_changes.evidence: NEO: I'm going in. TRINITY: You can't! NEO: I have to.

what_changes.before: Trying to stop Neo from going back in, citing Morpheus's sacrifice
what_changes.after: Joining Neo in the chair, asserting her rank and personal stake in Morpheus
what_changes.evidence: TRINITY: I believe Morpheus means more to me than he does to you. I believe that if you are serious about saving him then you are going to need my help

what_changes.before: Believing Morpheus must be unplugged to prevent his mind from being broken
what_changes.after: Acknowledging the situation as 'loco' and suicidal, but ultimately complying with the decision to load Neo and Trinity
what_changes.evidence: TANK: Neo, this is loco. They've got Morpheus in a military controlled building. Even if you somehow got inside, those are Agents holding him. Three of them!

event_hint.one_line: Neo and Trinity decide to re-enter the Matrix to save Morpheus before his mind is broken.
